ideas.description: Exploit, a numerically equivalent throughput cut. On the current tip (E038: 2x20+3x24+2x28+4x32 px, 2/3/3 net, Muon at batch 1536 with AOL plus 2 NS steps, conv1 block frozen at 32 px, ls 0.4; 0.7546 @ 6.68 s), replace the head's AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) with x.flatten(2).amax(2), or an equivalent amax over dims (2,3), in every resolution's forward. Change nothing else. Recapture all 4 CUDA graphs and the eval path in build. Confirm that eval still returns finite [B,100] logits for B in {1, 7, 513, 1024}. In the smoke test, log ms/step per phase and a one-step profiler line for the pooling backward kernel (atomic adaptive_max_pool2d_backward vs the amax backward).
ideas.expected: Time falls 0.5-1.5% (about 6.59-6.65 s vs 6.68 s), because the atomic scatter in the adaptive-max backward is gone at all 4 resolutions. Accuracy should be bit-identical or within ±0.05 pp of 0.7546; only fp16 tie-breaking in the gradient can differ. Keep if time is >=0.5% lower and the 3-seed mean is >=0.753. If time changes by <0.3%, the pooling backward is not a measurable cost, H2.6.1 is refuted and H2.6's kernel-efficiency lever drops in confidence. This is removed work, so it should carry over to the PCIe judge.

ideas.description: Exploit and add margin by fixing a BN-statistics mismatch (D004 C0031/C0035). Lookahead copies the slow weights into the model at the end of training, but the BN running statistics were accumulated under the fast iterates, and the frozen block's stats under the detach regime. At the end of train(), after the final Lookahead sync, reset all BN running stats. Re-estimate them with cumulative averaging (momentum=None) from 6 forward-only batches of 1536 un-augmented, un-flipped 32 px training images (no_grad, fp16, channels_last). Draw the images with the trial-seeded generator, then restore BN momentum. Do the re-estimation pass in a small CUDA graph or compiled function warmed up in build on synthetic data, so its first call costs nothing extra in the timed region. Training data only; the test set is never touched. Change nothing else on E038. Run salt 0 and salt 1.
ideas.expected: Time rises by 0.04-0.07 s (+0.6-1%, about 6.73-6.75 s). The 2-salt mean rises 0.05-0.3 pp over the tip's 0.7527, centred near +0.15 pp (about 0.754). Keep it if the 2-salt mean is >=0.7545 and salt 0 is >=0.753; that margin then pays for the E037-style 28 px shift (-0.10 s) or extending the freeze to 28 px. If the gain is <0.05 pp, the running stats already match the slow weights: refute the BN-mismatch part of H2.3.2 and close the BN-stat lever.

ideas.description: Exploit and buy margin through cheap deep capacity, at equal epochs (the test E008 confounded). On E038, widen group 3 from 576 to 768 channels (128/384/768) at every resolution and adjust the head input to match. Keep epochs, resolution schedule, LR schedule, Muon lr/momentum, ls 0.4, freezing and the whitening-bias window fixed. Recapture all 4 graphs in build. Log ms/step per phase. Run salt 0 and salt 1.
ideas.expected: Time +3-6% (about 6.9-7.05 s): group 3 runs at 4x4 to 2.5x2.5, where E004 measured only +6%/step for +19% MACs, and the low-res phases add less. The 2-salt mean rises 0.15-0.45 pp over 0.7527, centred near +0.3 pp (about 0.7555). H6.1.1 is supported if the gain is >=0.3 pp for <=+5% time. In that case keep it, and spend the margin next on the 28 px shift (E037: -0.10 s) and the 28 px freeze (H2.4.6), which together should more than repay the time. If the gain is <0.15 pp, H6.1 is weakened and H6's capacity route is closed for group 3.

ideas.description: Exploit, removing low-res backward work. On E038, train the whitening-conv bias for only the first ~0.25 epoch (8 steps at batch 1536), as Fable and Hiverge do, instead of the first 5 epochs. After that, detach the whitening output (after its activation) in every phase, including 20 and 24 px. The 20/24 px phases then also skip the first group-1 conv's dgrad and the whitening BN/activation backward. Capture a no-detach 20 px graph for the first 8 steps plus the detached 20/24 px graphs in build, so nothing is captured in the timed region (5 graphs in total). Drop the whitening bias from the optimizer, or zero its lr, after step 8. Change nothing else.
ideas.expected: 20/24 px ms/step falls 3-6%, so total time falls 1-2% (about 6.55-6.62 s). Accuracy within ±0.15 pp of the tip (E029 found 3 vs 5 epochs of bias training neutral). Keep if the 3-seed mean is >=0.753 and time is >=1% lower; run a salt-1 companion if salt 0 lands in 0.753-0.7545. If accuracy falls >=0.25 pp, the whitening bias needs the early phase; refute H2.4.5.

ideas.description: Calibration (no recipe change), to set the keep rule. Using the existing internal salt / trial-seed plumbing, run the E038 tip recipe on dev seeds 3-12 outside the official command (10 trials, same code), and log per-seed accuracy and time. Nothing is kept from this run. The result replaces the 2-salt guesses with a 10-seed estimate of the recipe's true mean and per-seed std, and tests whether official seeds 0-2 are a favourable draw: salt-1 draws came in lower three times (E027, E034, E039).
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (about 6.68 s per trial). 10-seed mean in [0.7500, 0.7535], centred near 0.752, below the kept 0.7546, with a per-seed std of 0.15-0.4 pp. If the mean is <0.7525, enforce the H4 rule: no numerics-changing time cut is kept until a margin-adding change (BN re-estimation, group-3 width) passes with 2 salts. Only bit-identical cuts (amax pooling) stay allowed. If the mean is >=0.753, salt 0 is representative, and single-draw keeps at >=0.7535 are acceptable again.

ideas.description: Exploit, a kernel-efficiency cut in the most expensive phase. On E038, during the 4 epochs at 32 px, switch the frozen first group-1 block's BatchNorm to eval mode: it uses fixed running stats, gets no batch-stat reductions and no stat updates. Before entering the 32 px phase, re-estimate that one BN's running stats from 2 forward-only 32 px training batches (cumulative average), so its fixed affine matches the 32 px input distribution. Fold it into a per-channel scale/shift fused after the conv if inductor allows. Capture the modified 32 px graph and the tiny re-estimation pass in build. Change nothing else.
ideas.expected: 32 px ms/step falls 1.5-3%, so total time falls 0.7-1.5% (about 6.59-6.64 s). Accuracy within ±0.15 pp: the block is frozen and its output distribution becomes deterministic per image, which may even reduce train/test mismatch. Keep if the 3-seed mean is >=0.753 and time is >=0.7% lower. If accuracy drops >=0.25 pp, the batch-stat noise in that block acts as useful regularization at 32 px; refute H2.6.2.

ideas.description: Explore a margin source inside Muon at no time cost. On E038, replace the 2 fixed quintic NS steps that follow AOL preconditioning with Polar Express per-iteration minimax coefficients for 2 iterations (arXiv 2505.16932), with the lower singular-value bound set to ~1e-3 and the safety factor from the paper. AOL already bounds sigma_max <= 1. Use the same matmul count, the same lr 0.205, momentum 0.655 and per-step renorm. Before running, validate offline on 3 real momentum-gradient matrices captured from a dev training step (not Gaussian; the E035 lesson) that the smallest decile of singular values is lifted higher than with the current coefficients. Recapture all graphs in build. Run salt 0 and salt 1.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%). The 2-salt mean rises 0.0-0.25 pp over 0.7527, centred near +0.1 pp. Keep if the 2-salt mean is >=0.7545. If it rises >=0.15 pp, the orthogonalization quality on the small-singular-value tail is a margin lever, and 2-step PE may later make room for other cuts. If it changes by <0.1 pp, orthogonalization quality past 2 AOL+NS steps is saturated; close H1.7.9.

ideas.description: Explore an output knob that has never been swept and costs nothing. On E038 (ls 0.4), multiply the head's fixed output scale (the airbench 1/9-style logit multiplier, rescaled for 100 classes) by 2x and change nothing else. The scale is a graph constant, so recapture all graphs in build. Run salt 0 and salt 1. Contingency: if the 2-salt mean falls by >=0.15 pp, run 0.5x next. Larger smoothing (ls 0.4) lowers the optimal logit magnitude, so the scale and ls interact.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%). The 2-salt mean moves by -0.3 to +0.3 pp with no strong prior; the scale changes both the head's effective lr and the logit-margin target under ls 0.4. Keep if the 2-salt mean is >=0.7545. A |delta| >=0.15 pp in either direction supports H1.3.4 and sets the direction for the next run. A |delta| <0.1 pp refutes H1.3.4 and closes the output-regularization knobs (ls and scale) as margin sources.

structured_output.summary:
The queue was empty, so I added 8 new ideas; there is nothing to drop. The current tip is E038, which scored 0.7546 on the official seeds (salt 0) at 6.68 s, but its 2-salt mean is only about 0.7527. That makes margin the binding constraint, and the queue is built around it.

**Safest time cut (priority 5):** swap the head's adaptive max pool for `amax` (H2.6.1). The numerics stay the same, so it can be kept without spending margin.

**Margin-adding exploits (priority 4), each judged with 2 salts:**
- Re-estimate the BN running stats after the final Lookahead sync, using a few un-augmented 32 px training batches (H2.3.2, from D004).
- Widen group 3 to 768 at equal epochs (H6.1.1). This is the clean capacity test that E008 confounded with an epoch cut.

**Further time cuts (priority 3):** these change numerics, so they are judged against the bar plus a companion run:
- Train the whitening bias for only ~0.25 epoch, then detach its output in every phase (H2.4.5).
- Put the frozen block's BN in eval mode at 32 px (H2.6.2).

**Calibration (priority 3):** a 10-dev-seed run of the tip (H4.3.1), to measure the winner's-curse bias and settle the keep rule.

**Explores (priority 2):** Polar Express coefficients for the Newton-Schulz steps (H1.7.9), checked first on real gradient matrices, and a 2x head logit-scale sweep under ls 0.4 (H1.3.4).

If a margin-adding idea passes, that margin can pay for the time cuts that were blocked: the E037 28 px shift and freezing conv1 at 28 px (H2.4.6).
